faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.text: Maintenance depends on your lawn type and needs. Typically weekly or bi-weekly visits keep your garden healthy and looking smart.
faq.cardText: Bring your garden to life with expert care and clear, friendly advice from a team that treats every outdoor space with care.

items.question: How often should I schedule lawn maintenance?
items.answer: Most gardens benefit from weekly or fortnightly visits during the growing season.

items.question: What are the benefits of aerating my lawn?
items.answer: Aeration helps air, water and nutrients reach the roots for stronger growth.

items.question: When is the best time to fertilise my lawn?
items.answer: Spring and early autumn are usually best for UK lawns.

items.question: How can I control weeds in my lawn?
items.answer: Regular mowing, feeding and targeted weed treatment help keep lawns clean.

items.question: What type of grass is best for my climate?
items.answer: We recommend blends based on shade, usage, drainage and soil type.
